    Interface EmapEventMap

    Typed payloads for every event emitted ON the Emap instance (P10). Scoped to this.fire(…) in src/map/map.ts + the camera lifecycle wired through the camera host. Handler-internal events (pan, panstart, mousewheel*) and sub-dispatcher events (tick, change, workerjob*, source dataloading) are intentionally excluded — they are not delivered via map.on.

    This is an interface (not a type) so consumers can augment it:

    declare module '@zwishing/emap' {
      interface EmapEventMap { myCustomEvent: { detail: string } }
    }
    interface EmapEventMap {
        crschange: Record<never, never>;
        data: {
            reason?: "replace" | "load" | "edit" | "reproject";
            sourceId?: string;
        };
        editmodechange: { mode: EditMode };
        error: { error: Error };
        "feature:click": FeatureEvent;
        "feature:enter": FeatureEvent;
        "feature:hover": FeatureEvent;
        "feature:leave": FeatureEvent;
        historychange: Partial<HistoryStateSnapshot>;
        mousemove: PointerMoveEvent;
        move: Partial<CameraEvent>;
        moveend: CameraEvent;
        movestart: CameraEvent;
        myAugmentedEvent: { detail: string };
        resize: Record<never, never>;
        selectionchange: {
            added: FeatureRef[];
            removed: FeatureRef[];
            selected: FeatureRef[];
        };
        validationfailed: { label: string; results: ValidatorResult[] };
        zoom: CameraEvent;
        zoomend: CameraEvent;
        zoomstart: CameraEvent;
    }
